newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Venezuela's Cisneros eyes Colombia expansion - paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Cisneros eyes Colombia expansion - paper.

text.p: One of Venezuela's most powerful industrial conglomerates, the Cisneros group, is eyeing new opportunities in the Colombian television and long-distance telecommunications market, local media reported Monday.
"If the rules of the new television law are flexible and modern, we will very interested in the business," said group chairman Gustavo Cisneros in an interview with the leading newspaper El Tiempo.

Colombia's constitutional court approved a new television law last week, requiring programmers to submit fresh bids for broadcast slots on the two state-run channels. The legislation also allows for the creation of two private channels with national coverage. The new regime will take effect next January.
Cisneros is currently a partner with Colombia's Santo Domingo group and Carvajal in Direct TV, a satellite television venture.

Gustavo Cisneros said his group was also interested in opportunities in Colombia's long-distance telecommunications market, saying he preferred to focus on specialty business services in that business.
